title: Samsung Faces Local Hedge Fund’s Push to Cancel Preferred Shares
summary: A South Korean hedge fund is urging Samsung Electronics Co. to buy back and cancel preferred shares, becoming one of the first shareholders to directly press for the step in hopes of boosting valuation.

title: BetMGM CEO on Early NFL Betting and Prediction Markets
summary: With Week 1 of the NFL season wrapping up, Adam Greenblatt, CEO of BetMGM, said the season has started enthusiastically and that early activity has been strong. He added that, from the bookmakers’ perspective, Sunday was not a favorable day because the fans came out ahead, leaving bettors happy and operators with an early loss. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Authentic Brands Targets Creator Economy, Eyes Public Offering
summary: Authentic Brands Group, a licensor of everything from Elvis Presley’s image to the Reebok sportswear brand, could pursue an initial public stock offering as early as the first half of next year.

title: Teva CEO on Shares Trading Directly on the NYSE
summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals President & CEO Richard Francis, discusses why Teva chose to make the change now and what will be different for investors as the shares move from ADRs to direct NYSE trading. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney Courts World’s Top Investors at Toronto Summit
summary: Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney is gathering some of the world’s top investors Monday night and Tuesday as he seeks to attract more investment into the country while reducing its reliance on the US and diversifying its markets.

title: Lincoln Center Kicks Off Fall Season
summary: The Lincoln Center in NYC has welcomed 600,000 new audience members in the years since the COVID-19 pandemic, offering free of low-cost performances to attract new audiences. Chief Artistic Officer Shanta Thake shares what is on schedule for the Lincoln Center's fall programming, and why she thinks the institution has thrived in the live performance and arts space for so many decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Global Impact of AI 'Apocalypse'
summary: A new Bloomberg Economics report estimates that advanced economies have 27% of employment meaningfully exposed to the first-order effects of AI. Chief Economist Tom Orlik breaks down the new study, which breaks down which jobs and tasks AI can takeover, and how they got to the number of 380 million jobs that may eventually be significantly impacted by new technology.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Boomer Candy Leads To Boomer Cavities: Huszczo

title: Apollo’s Michaels Uses $101 Million of Tariff Refund to Cut Debt
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc.-owned retailer Michaels Cos. used a windfall from tariff refunds to help cut its leverage, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Sysco Seeks to Raise $1 Billion in Share Sale for Jetro Deal
summary: Sysco Corp. is seeking to raise $1 billion in a share sale to partially fund the food service firm’s $29.1 billion acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot LLC.

title: S&P 500 Seen Dropping 10% on Fed Hikes, MRA Strategist Says
summary: Potential Federal Reserve rate hikes starting this week could spur a correction in the S&P 500 as reduced corporate margins hurt profit outlooks and markets brace for a tightening cycle, according to Macro Risk Advisors LLC.

title: Crafting America’s Countertops is Killing Workers
summary: Silicosis is an incurable workplace disease. Countertop fabrication workers around the country who have contracted the illness are suing the artificial stone industry for billions. However, while California weighs a ban on the product, the manufacturers’ defenders in Congress are trying to ban the lawsuits. Josh Eidelson explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tema Rolls 'DICE' On SpaceX, Prediction Markets

Paisley Nardini, head of investment strategy at Tema ETFs, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss Tema Trading & Prediction Markets ETF (ticker: DICE) and Tema Space Innovators ETF (ticker: NASA). 

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging Markets Slide as Oil, AI Concerns Sap Risk Appetite
summary: Emerging-market assets fell at the start of a key week for global markets, as elevated oil prices and concerns over the pace of artificial-intelligence development weighed on currencies and stocks ahead of an expected Federal Reserve interest-rate hike — its first since 2023.
